dev.connect.title: mecahub hub connection test
dev.connect.intro: Developer page. Turn the hub on (press its green button), then press Connect and pick it in the list.
dev.connect.unsupported: This browser cannot use Web Bluetooth. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
dev.connect.unsupportedLinux: On Linux, Chrome may need this flag enabled: chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features
dev.connect.error.unsupported: This browser cannot use Web Bluetooth.
dev.connect.error.gatt: The Bluetooth connection failed. Check that the hub is on and close to the computer, then try again.
dev.sim.title: mecahub simulator
dev.sim.intro: Developer page. A simulated Move Hub on the left, an app connected to it on the right. Behaviours marked as assumed are not verified on real hardware.
dev.sim.appIntro: Press Connect to link the app to the simulated hub.
dev.sim.sensorsNote: Sensor values use a simple assumed layout, not verified on hardware.
dev.sim.latencyHint: A STOP write that takes longer than its deadline drops the link.
dev.sim.stopPending: Waiting for the motors to stop...
dev.sim.stopFailed: The STOP did not reach the hub. The motors may still be running.
dev.lab.title: mecahub lab
dev.lab.intro: Developer page for hardware sessions: connect a hub, drive it, measure it and export what it said. It is not part of the app.
dev.lab.stopHint: Stops every motor. The Escape key does the same. This button always works, even when nothing is connected.
dev.lab.stopLatency: STOP time (until the STOP writes finished; this is not the time the motors physically stopped)
dev.lab.stopWithin: {ms} ms until every STOP write finished, within the {budget} ms limit.
dev.lab.stopOver: {ms} ms until every STOP write finished, over the {budget} ms limit.
dev.lab.stopFailed: {errors} STOP write(s) failed ({ms} ms). The motors may still be running.
dev.lab.connection.heading: Connection
dev.lab.mode.label: Hub to use
dev.lab.mode.unavailable: This browser has no Web Bluetooth, so only the simulator is available.
dev.lab.mode.simulatorNote: Simulator results are not hardware measurements. Do not save them as fixtures.
dev.lab.timings.heading: Timings
dev.lab.timings.chooser: Chooser (click until a hub is picked)
dev.lab.devices.heading: Devices
dev.lab.motors.heading: Motors
dev.lab.motor.title: Motor {name}
dev.lab.led.label: Hub light
dev.lab.sensors.heading: Readings
dev.lab.measure.heading: Measurements
dev.lab.measure.intro: Each button answers one open question about the real hub (see the README). Results appear below and go into the export.
dev.lab.tool.writeLatency.about: How long a write takes and how long the hub takes to answer. Sends 20 harmless battery requests.
dev.lab.tool.motorSpeed.about: How fast the motor turns at full speed and at half. The motor spins for about a second twice: lift the robot.
dev.lab.tool.multiMessageWrite.about: Whether the hub understands two messages sent in one Bluetooth write.
dev.lab.tool.stopOnLinkLoss.about: Whether the hub stops its motors by itself when the connection is cut.
dev.lab.tool.feedback.about: Turns motor A a quarter turn and records every completion report the hub sends.
dev.lab.latency.write: Write finished: min {min}, median {p50}, p95 {p95}, max {max} ms
dev.lab.latency.rtt: Request to reply: min {min}, median {p50}, p95 {p95}, max {max} ms
dev.lab.latency.counts: {completed} of {requested} writes done, {errors} failed, {lost} without a reply
dev.lab.speed.run: At {speed}%: at least {degPerSec} deg/s while moving ({wall} deg/s over the whole command), {degrees} deg, maximum at 100% at least about {max} deg/s ({status})
dev.lab.speed.noData: At {speed}%: no position change was reported ({status})
dev.lab.multi.first-only: The hub answered only the first message.
dev.lab.multi.second-only: The hub answered only the second message.
dev.lab.multi.none: The hub answered neither message within 1 second.
dev.lab.linkLoss.warning: Safety: motor A spins at a slow speed and then the connection is cut. Lift the robot so the wheels turn freely, or take them off.
dev.lab.linkLoss.confirm: I lifted the robot and the wheels are free
dev.lab.linkLoss.start: Spin motor A and cut the connection
dev.lab.linkLoss.awaiting: The connection is cut, so STOP cannot reach the hub now. Watch motor A for a few seconds. If the motor keeps turning, switch the hub off. Did it stop by itself?
dev.lab.linkLoss.reconnectNote: After your answer the lab reconnects and sends STOP, always.
dev.lab.linkLoss.done: You saw: {observation}. Reconnected: {reconnected}. STOP after reconnecting: {stop}.
dev.lab.linkLoss.aborted: Cancelled by STOP. The connection was kept.
dev.lab.linkLoss.notReconnected: The lab could not reconnect: the motor may still be turning. Switch the hub off.
dev.lab.diag.heading: Diagnostics
dev.lab.diag.unattributed-error: Error the hub did not tie to a request
dev.lab.diag.unknown-value: Value the lab could not read
dev.lab.diag.decode-error: Message that could not be decoded
dev.lab.diag.framing-error: Notification that did not split into messages
dev.lab.export.heading: Export
dev.lab.export.note: Save a capture as a fixture only when it comes from a real hub.
dev.lab.error.busy: Another measurement is running, or the lab is not free right now.
dev.lab.error.no-motor: There is no motor on that port.
dev.lab.error.no-observation: Say what you saw on the motor first.
dev.lab.tool.motorSpeed.warning: Safety: the motor spins at full speed for about a second, twice. Lift the robot so the wheels turn freely, or take them off.
dev.lab.error.command-failed: A command the test needs could not be sent, so the test was cancelled and the motors were stopped.
dev.lab.export.selected: The browser would not copy. The capture is selected below: press Ctrl+C.
dev.lab.tool.feedback.warning: Safety: motor A turns a quarter turn. Lift the robot so the wheels turn freely, or take them off.
